senses.en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand
Make something carefully and skilfully
A boat, aircraft, or spacecraft

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on landing craft.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论登陆艇。

ex.en: The reading connects landing craft with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把登陆艇和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: craft a proposal｜精心拟订提案
tip: 表示船或飞行器时，craft的单复数形式相同。

senses.en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.
A smell left behind that an animal can follow.
To detect something by its smell.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a delicate scent in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了淡淡的香味。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a delicate scent.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕淡淡的香味展开说明。

col: follow a scent｜循着气味追踪
tip: scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。

senses.en: showing strong moral qualities and concern for others
belonging to a family with high inherited social rank
a person belonging to a high-ranking hereditary social class

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about noble cause.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于崇高的事业的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to noble cause when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了崇高的事业。

tip: 表示“高尚的”时强调品德，而非社会地位。

senses.en: unfair treatment based on someone's identity or personal characteristics
the ability or process of noticing differences between things

ex.en: The textbook introduces racial discrimination in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了种族歧视。

ex.en: The author returns to racial discrimination when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了种族歧视。

tip: 歧视某群体用 discrimination against；通常不可数。

senses.en: a medieval soldier of high rank who fought on horseback
a man awarded a title of honour by a monarch
a chess piece shaped like a horse's head

ex.en: Office hours began with medieval knight.
ex.zh: 答疑从中世纪骑士开始。

ex.en: The reading connects medieval knight with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把中世纪骑士和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: award a knighthood｜授予爵士头衔
tip: k不发音，与night同音；爵士头衔常用Sir。

senses.en: Materials used to wrap and protect products.

ex.en: The textbook introduces recyclable packaging in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了可回收包装。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around recyclable packaging.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕可回收包装展开说明。

tip: 表示包装材料时通常不可数；一件包裹用package。

senses.en: To suggest something without stating it directly.
To involve something as a necessary result or condition.

ex.en: The assignment is to imply that, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先暗示……，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to imply that.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们暗示……。

col: not necessarily imply｜不一定意味着
tip: imply是说话者暗示；infer是听者推断。

senses.en: A fungus used to make bread rise and produce alcohol.

ex.en: I copied dried yeast into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把干酵母抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dried yeast.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论干酵母的材料。

tip: 烘焙中通常作不可数名词；不是baking powder。

senses.en: Something that briefly stops an activity, conversation, or continuous process.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on interruption to services.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论服务中断。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around interruption to services.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕服务中断展开说明。

tip: 一次打断可数；without interruption表示不间断。

senses.en: a person who studies how language works
a person skilled at speaking or learning several languages

ex.en: Our professor circled applied linguist on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了应用语言学家。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of applied linguist.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得应用语言学家这个例子。

col: trained linguist｜受过专业训练的语言学家
tip: linguist 指人；linguistics 指语言学，作单数学科名。

senses.en: Relating to the region around the North Pole.
Extremely cold.
The region surrounding the North Pole.

ex.en: I copied the Arctic into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把北极地区抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used the Arctic to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用北极地区来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指北极地区时用the Arctic；南极是the Antarctic。

senses.en: Clearly noticeable and often substantial
Having a visible mark that identifies or distinguishes something

ex.en: I copied clearly marked into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把标记清楚的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around clearly marked.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕标记清楚的展开说明。

tip: 学术写作中常表示“显著的”；词尾读/t/。

senses.en: Close to the actual amount or value, but not exact
To be close to something in amount, quality, or character

ex.en: I copied approximate cost into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把大致费用抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used approximate cost to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用大致费用来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 形容词词尾读/mət/，动词词尾读/meɪt/。

senses.en: Really or genuinely, rather than only apparently
With sincere feelings or intentions

ex.en: The professor told us to truly believe and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们真心相信，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will truly believe when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会真心相信。

tip: true变truly时去掉e，不能写成truely。

senses.en: To give someone a task, role, or resource
To give something a particular value or category

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to assign a task.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须分配任务。

ex.en: The reading asks you to assign a task and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你分配任务，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: assign someone to a team｜将某人分配到团队
tip: 常用assign sth to sb，也可用assign sb sth。

senses.en: a large farm building for storing crops or keeping animals

ex.en: The textbook introduces wooden barn in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了木制谷仓。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around wooden barn.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕木制谷仓展开说明。

col: store hay in a barn｜把干草存入谷仓
tip: 指农场里的大型建筑，可储存农作物或饲养牲畜。

senses.en: A gas formed when a liquid or solid changes state.

ex.en: Office hours began with water vapour.
ex.zh: 答疑从水蒸气开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss water vapour.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论水蒸气的材料。

tip: 英式拼写为vapour，美式为vapor。

senses.en: To refuse to accept, approve, or believe something.
To remove something because it is faulty or unsuitable.
An item not accepted because it fails to meet standards.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to reject a proposal.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求否决提案。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to reject a proposal.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来否决提案。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈriːdʒekt/。

senses.en: acts of showing respect and devotion to a god
to show respect and devotion to a god
to admire or love someone extremely strongly

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on place of worship.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论宗教礼拜场所。

ex.en: A campus survey used place of worship to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用宗教礼拜场所来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: place of worship｜宗教礼拜场所
freedom of worship｜宗教礼拜自由
tip: 英式过去式worshipped，美式通常worshiped。

senses.en: An unsupported belief linking events or actions to supernatural forces.

ex.en: Office hours began with popular superstition.
ex.zh: 答疑从流行的迷信观念开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss popular superstition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论流行的迷信观念的材料。

col: superstition about bad luck｜关于厄运的迷信
tip: 泛指迷信用不可数；某种迷信观念可数。

senses.en: the process of judging something's quality, value, or effectiveness

ex.en: Office hours began with performance evaluation.
ex.zh: 答疑从绩效评估开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used performance evaluation to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用绩效评估来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: carry out an evaluation｜开展评估
tip: 常接of；强调质量或效果，价格估值常用valuation。

senses.en: an act that breaks a law, rule, or agreement
an act that disregards someone's rights or privacy

ex.en: Office hours began with a traffic violation.
ex.zh: 答疑从交通违章开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a traffic violation to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用交通违章来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: a violation of the law｜违法行为
a violation of privacy｜侵犯隐私
tip: 用a violation of表示违反或侵犯某事物。

senses.en: A careful examination to check condition, quality, or safety.

ex.en: Our professor circled safety inspection on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全检查。

ex.en: The reading connects safety inspection with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把安全检查和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: carry out an inspection｜进行检查
tip: inspection指检查过程；检查某物用of连接。

senses.en: the ability or activity of guiding people towards shared goals
the people who direct an organisation or country

ex.en: Our professor circled strong leadership on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了有力的领导。

ex.en: The author returns to strong leadership when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有力的领导。

col: under the leadership of｜在……的领导下
tip: 通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。

senses.en: Important, well known, or influential
Easily noticed because of position, size, or shape

ex.en: Our professor circled a prominent role on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了重要作用。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a prominent role.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕重要作用展开说明。

tip: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形显眼。

senses.en: money received for doing work
profits made by a company during a particular period

ex.en: Office hours began with annual earnings.
ex.zh: 答疑从年收入开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of annual earnings.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得年收入这个例子。

tip: 以-s结尾的复数名词，作主语时谓语用复数。

senses.en: Moving gently back and forth, often in the wind.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on waving branches.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论摇摆的树枝。

ex.en: The reading connects waving branches with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把摇摆的树枝和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: gently waving grass｜轻轻摇曳的草
tip: 多为wave的现在分词；静态的“波浪状”通常用wavy。

senses.en: Your inner sense of what is right and wrong.
Guilt about something wrong you have done.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a clear conscience.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于问心无愧的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a clear conscience.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论问心无愧的材料。

col: a matter of conscience｜良心问题
tip: conscience是良心；conscious是有意识的。

senses.en: Making you think something is wrong, dishonest, or illegal.
Feeling that someone or something cannot be trusted.

ex.en: Office hours began with highly suspicious.
ex.zh: 答疑从非常可疑的开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly suspicious.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕非常可疑的展开说明。

col: suspicious of someone｜对某人心存怀疑
tip: 事物可疑用suspicious；怀疑某事用suspicious of。

senses.en: A unit measuring energy, especially energy in food.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on calorie intake.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热量摄入。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss calorie intake.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论热量摄入的材料。

tip: 食品语境的calorie通常指千卡；物理学中指卡。

senses.en: An ordered series of things, actions, or events.
To arrange things or events in a particular order.

ex.en: Office hours began with the correct sequence.
ex.zh: 答疑从正确顺序开始。

ex.en: The author returns to the correct sequence when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了正确顺序。

col: a sequence of events｜一连串事件
tip: a sequence of后接复数名词，表示一连串事物。

senses.en: having no living members left
describing a volcano not expected to erupt again

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about extinct species.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于已灭绝物种的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to extinct species when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了已灭绝物种。

tip: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

senses.en: Lower in quality, value, or ability than something else.
Having a lower rank or position.
Someone with a lower rank or position than another person.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on inferior to.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论不如……的。

ex.en: A campus survey used inferior to to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用不如……的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 比较用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。

senses.en: Advice or a principle explaining how something should be done.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize guideline in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出准则。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses guideline when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了准则。

tip: 常用复数guidelines；通常指指导而非强制法规。

senses.en: An edible nut with a wrinkled kernel and hard shell.
A tree producing walnuts, or its wood used for furniture.

ex.en: Office hours began with walnut shell.
ex.zh: 答疑从核桃壳开始。

ex.en: The reading connects walnut shell with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把核桃壳和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 指核桃或树时可数，指核桃木材时不可数。

senses.en: to find and employ workers or attract new members
someone who has recently joined an organization or armed force

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to recruit staff.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何招聘员工。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to recruit staff.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来招聘员工。

tip: recruit可作动词或可数名词；招聘活动用recruitment。

senses.en: Make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem.
Try to stop an opponent or take their ball.
Equipment used for an activity, especially fishing.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to tackle a problem.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须处理问题。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to tackle a problem.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来处理问题。

tip: tackle直接接问题，不加with；强调着手应对。

senses.en: an evil character in a story, or a cruel person
someone or something considered responsible for a problem

ex.en: The textbook introduces the real villain in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了真正的罪魁祸首。

ex.en: The reading connects the real villain with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把真正的罪魁祸首和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the villain of the story｜故事中的反派
the real villain｜真正的罪魁祸首
tip: 常指故事中的反派；别与villa“别墅”混淆。

senses.en: To enter another country by force to take control
To enter or affect someone's private space without permission
To arrive somewhere in large, often unwelcome groups

ex.en: The professor asked us to invade a country.
ex.zh: 教授让我们入侵一个国家。

ex.en: A lecture on historical change showed why researchers invade a country before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于历史变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要入侵一个国家。

col: invade a country｜入侵一个国家
invade someone's privacy｜侵犯某人的隐私
invade personal space｜侵入个人空间
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；名词形式是invasion。

senses.en: The process of arranging things into groups by shared features.
A category to which something is officially assigned.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about data classification.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于数据分类的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of data classification.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得数据分类这个例子。

tip: classify A as B表示“把A归为B类”。

senses.en: The act of copying someone's behaviour or something's appearance.
An object made to look like another, often more valuable, object.
Made to resemble a natural or more expensive material.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a poor imitation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论拙劣的模仿；劣质仿品。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a poor imitation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论拙劣的模仿；劣质仿品的材料。

col: learn by imitation｜通过模仿学习
a poor imitation｜拙劣的模仿；劣质仿品
tip: 模仿行为通常不可数；一件仿制品用an imitation。

senses.en: Action taken to stop something unwanted from happening.

ex.en: The textbook introduces disease prevention in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了疾病预防。

ex.en: The author returns to disease prevention when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了疾病预防。

tip: 通常不可数；动词搭配为prevent sb from doing。

senses.en: Increase the range of knowledge, experience, or available choices.
Become wider, or make something wider.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to broaden your horizons.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求开阔眼界。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to broaden your horizons.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得开阔眼界。

col: broaden access to｜扩大获得……的机会
tip: 常用于抽象范围；broaden your horizons指开阔眼界。

senses.en: the central or most important part of something
central and essential to something
to remove the hard central part of a fruit

ex.en: Our professor circled apple core on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了苹果核。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of apple core.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得苹果核这个例子。

col: at the core of｜处于……的核心
tip: 果核指苹果等的中央硬部；桃核通常用stone。

senses.en: a device that moves liquid or gas
to move liquid or gas using a pump

ex.en: I copied water pump into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把水泵抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss water pump.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论水泵的材料。

col: pump up a tyre｜给轮胎打气
tip: pump up a tyre表示给轮胎打气；抽水用pump water。

senses.en: Not clearly expressed or lacking specific details
Not clear in shape, memory, or feeling

ex.en: The textbook introduces vague idea in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了模糊的想法。

ex.en: A campus survey used vague idea to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用模糊的想法来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: be vague about表示对某事说不清或含糊其词。

senses.en: To take money out of a bank account
To leave an activity or move away from a place
To remove something offered or take back a statement

ex.en: The professor asked us to withdraw cash.
ex.zh: 教授让我们提取现金。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to withdraw cash.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们提取现金。

col: withdraw from a competition｜退出比赛
tip: 过去式withdrew，过去分词withdrawn；退出用from。

senses.en: An animal hunted and eaten by another animal.
Someone targeted for harm or exploitation.
To hunt animals or exploit vulnerable people, usually with on.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about birds of prey.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于猛禽的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of birds of prey.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得猛禽这个例子。

col: prey on small animals｜捕食小动物
fall prey to fraud｜成为诈骗受害者
tip: 名词通常不可数；动词常用prey on；勿混pray。

senses.en: Honestly expressing what you really feel or believe

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sincere apology.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论诚恳的道歉。

ex.en: The author returns to sincere apology when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了诚恳的道歉。

tip: sincere强调不虚假；sincerely常用于信件结尾。

senses.zh: 使不知所措；使情绪难抑
senses.en: To affect someone so strongly they cannot cope.
To give a system or person more than they can handle.
To defeat someone using much greater strength.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to overwhelm local services.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使当地服务不堪重负。

ex.en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to overwhelm local services.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们使当地服务不堪重负。

col: be overwhelmed by emotion｜情绪激动得难以自持
overwhelm local services｜使当地服务不堪重负
tip: 人感到 overwhelmed；事物令人 overwhelming。

senses.en: Officially join, or register someone for, a course or organisation.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer enrol on a course during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时报名课程。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to enrol on a course.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们报名课程。

col: enrol on a course｜报名课程
enrol in a programme｜报名项目
tip: 英式 enrol，美式 enroll；过去式均为 enrolled。

senses.en: An occasion when people meet again after time apart.

ex.en: The textbook introduces family reunion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了家庭团聚。

ex.en: The reading connects family reunion with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把家庭团聚和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 强调分别后的再相聚，不泛指任何聚会。

senses.en: Having four straight sides and four right angles

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a rectangular table.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论长方形桌子。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a rectangular table.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论长方形桌子的材料。

tip: rectangle是名词；rectangular是形容词。

senses.en: The activity of growing crops and raising animals for food.

ex.en: Office hours began with sustainable agriculture.
ex.zh: 答疑从可持续农业开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used sustainable agriculture to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用可持续农业来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 不可数名词；形容词为agricultural。

senses.en: a large amount of something gathered together
the amount of matter in an object
involving or affecting very large numbers of people

ex.en: Office hours began with body mass.
ex.zh: 答疑从身体质量开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used body mass to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用身体质量来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 物理学中mass指质量，weight指重量，二者不同。

senses.en: The act of renting something, or the money paid for it
Relating to renting, or available to rent
A house, vehicle, or other item that someone rents

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on car rental.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论汽车租赁。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of car rental.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得汽车租赁这个例子。

tip: 租金常用rent；rental还可指租赁服务或作形容词。

senses.en: Freedom from unwanted access to personal information or private life.
The state of being alone and free from disturbance.

ex.en: Office hours began with protect privacy.
ex.zh: 答疑从保护隐私开始。

ex.en: The author returns to protect privacy when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了保护隐私。

col: in the privacy of your home｜在家中不受打扰地
tip: 通常不可数；英美发音首音节差异明显。

senses.en: To put a substance into something using a needle or pressure.
To introduce money, energy, or something new into a situation.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer inject medicine during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时注射药物。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to inject medicine.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得注射药物。

col: inject new life into｜为……注入新生机
tip: 常用inject A into B：将A注入B。

senses.en: a university student studying for a first degree
relating to study for a first university degree

ex.en: Office hours began with undergraduate student.
ex.zh: 答疑从本科生开始。

ex.en: The reading connects undergraduate student with a larger point about student life.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把本科生和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 指正在攻读首个大学学位的学生，不等于“肄业生”。

senses.en: as a result of something mentioned earlier

ex.en: Consequently, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
ex.zh: 因此，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。

ex.en: Consequently, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
ex.zh: 因此，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。

tip: 是副词而非连词；连接独立句可在前面用分号。

senses.en: Very basic, without advanced features or modern comforts.
Belonging to an early stage of development.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on primitive tools.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论原始工具。

ex.en: A campus survey used primitive tools to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用原始工具来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

col: primitive life forms｜原始生命形式
tip: 形容设施可指简陋；用于当代民族或文化可能含贬义。

senses.en: The feeling that there is no hope.
To lose all hope that things will improve.

ex.en: Office hours began with a sense of despair.
ex.zh: 答疑从绝望感开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of despair.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝望感展开说明。

col: despair of doing something｜对做成某事不抱希望
tip: 名词通常不可数；动词常接of，不接直接宾语。

senses.en: To regularly check something for changes, progress, or problems.
A screen displaying information, or a device checking conditions.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to monitor progress.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何跟踪进展。

ex.en: The reading asks you to monitor progress and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你跟踪进展，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: monitor air quality｜监测空气质量
tip: 作动词可直接接宾语：monitor changes监测变化。

senses.en: An exercise machine with a moving surface for walking or running.
A tiring routine that seems endless and brings little satisfaction.

ex.en: Our professor circled treadmill workout on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了跑步机锻炼。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of treadmill workout.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得跑步机锻炼这个例子。

col: run on a treadmill｜在跑步机上跑步
the treadmill of daily life｜日常生活的单调忙碌
tip: 在跑步机上用on a treadmill，不用in。

senses.en: Use resources carefully to avoid wasting them.
Protect something valuable from damage, loss, or destruction.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to conserve energy.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何节约能源。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to conserve energy.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得节约能源。

tip: conserve强调节约或保护；reserve强调预留。

senses.en: A journalist reporting from a particular place or on a subject.
A person who exchanges letters or messages with someone.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on foreign correspondent.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论驻外记者。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss foreign correspondent.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论驻外记者的材料。

tip: 记者义常指驻某地或负责某领域的记者。

senses.en: a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an elderly widow.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论年长的寡妇。

ex.en: The reading connects an elderly widow with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把年长的寡妇和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: widow指丧偶女性；丧偶男性用widower。

senses.en: extremely funny and likely to make people laugh

ex.en: Our professor circled absolutely hilarious on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了极其好笑的。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of absolutely hilarious.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得极其好笑的这个例子。

tip: 强调“极其好笑”，不只是热闹或开心。

senses.en: to feel an uncomfortable sensation that makes you want to scratch
an uncomfortable feeling on your skin that makes you scratch
to want very much to do something

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to itch for a chance.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何渴望得到机会。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to itch for a chance.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们渴望得到机会。

col: itch to do something｜渴望做某事
itch for a chance｜渴望得到机会
tip: itch是发痒，scratch是挠；渴望常用be itching to。

senses.en: Financial support for an activity, often in exchange for publicity.

ex.en: I copied corporate sponsorship into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把企业赞助抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to corporate sponsorship when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了企业赞助。

tip: 核心是提供资金等支持，并不等于主办活动。

senses.en: Kindness shown by choosing not to punish or harm someone.

ex.en: Office hours began with beg for mercy.
ex.zh: 答疑从乞求宽恕开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss beg for mercy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论乞求宽恕的材料。

col: at the mercy of｜任由……摆布
tip: at the mercy of意为“任由……摆布”。

senses.en: a rule or condition that limits what is allowed

ex.en: Office hours began with age restriction.
ex.zh: 答疑从年龄限制开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss age restriction.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论年龄限制的材料。

tip: 对某事的限制用restriction on；具体规定常用复数。

senses.en: to say something suddenly and loudly because of strong emotion

ex.en: I heard the lecturer exclaim in surprise during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时惊讶地叫道。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to exclaim in surprise.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来惊讶地叫道。

tip: 强调因强烈情绪突然出声，常用于引述话语。

senses.en: Changed partly to suit a purpose or improve how something works.

ex.en: The textbook introduces slightly modified in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了略作修改的。

ex.en: The author returns to slightly modified when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了略作修改的。

tip: 强调经过改变，不一定表示质量有所提升。

senses.en: a substance that flows, such as a liquid or gas
likely to change rather than remain fixed
moving smoothly and continuously

ex.en: The textbook introduces fluid intake in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了液体摄入量。

ex.en: The reading connects fluid intake with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把液体摄入量和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a fluid situation｜不断变化的局势
tip: 日常语境多指液体；科学中的fluid也包括气体。

senses.en: a book about someone's life written by that person

ex.en: The textbook introduces a bestselling autobiography in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了畅销自传。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a bestselling autobiography.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得畅销自传这个例子。

tip: autobiography是本人写的自传；biography是传记。

senses.en: Slightly wet, rather than dry or soaked.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on moist soil.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论湿润的土壤。

ex.en: The author returns to moist soil when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了湿润的土壤。

col: keep something moist｜使某物保持湿润
tip: moist常指适度湿润；damp常带潮湿、不舒服之意。

senses.en: To understand something, especially a difficult idea.
To take and hold something firmly.
An understanding of something, or a firm hold.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to grasp a concept.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求理解概念。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to grasp a concept.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得理解概念。

col: a firm grasp of｜对……的扎实理解
within reach or grasp｜力所能及
tip: 表示理解时可作动词；名词常用a grasp of。

senses.en: A desire to upset or hurt someone deliberately.
To deliberately upset someone, often because you feel angry.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on out of spite.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论出于恶意。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around out of spite.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕出于恶意展开说明。

tip: in spite of后接名词或动名词，不直接接句子。

senses.en: something that encourages someone to act or work harder

ex.en: The textbook introduces financial incentive in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济激励。

ex.en: The author returns to financial incentive when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济激励。

tip: 常用 incentive to do sth，表示做某事的动力。

senses.en: Someone who votes or has the right to vote

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about registered voter.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于登记选民的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of registered voter.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得登记选民这个例子。

col: eligible voter｜有投票资格的选民
tip: voter指人，vote可指投票行为或一票。

senses.en: Someone competing with another for the same goal or advantage.
Be as good or impressive as someone or something.
Competing for the same goal or advantage.

ex.en: Our professor circled a major rival on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了主要竞争对手。

ex.en: The author returns to a major rival when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主要竞争对手。

col: a major rival｜主要竞争对手
rival someone in quality｜在质量上与某人匹敌
tip: rival作动词直接接宾语，无需加with。

senses.en: Relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities.

ex.en: The textbook introduces rural areas in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了农村地区。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of rural areas.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得农村地区这个例子。

tip: rural修饰乡村事物，urban修饰城市事物。

senses.en: knowing a lot about a particular subject

ex.en: The textbook introduces knowledgeable about in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……很了解。

ex.en: The reading connects knowledgeable about with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把对……很了解和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: knowledgeable staff｜专业知识丰富的员工
a knowledgeable guide｜知识丰富的导游
tip: 常用 knowledgeable about 表示对某领域了解很多。

senses.en: lasting or having effects for only a limited time

ex.en: The professor explained short-term with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了短期的。

ex.en: Students who can explain short-term usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释短期的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: 作定语常用连字符；in the short term不加。

senses.en: a reddish-brown metal used for wires, pipes, and coins
a coin made of copper or a similar metal

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about copper wire.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于铜线的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to copper wire when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了铜线。

tip: 表示金属铜时不可数；表示铜币时可数。

senses.en: a blood vessel that carries blood towards the heart
a thin tube carrying water and nutrients through a leaf
a narrow layer of mineral within rock

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a vein of gold.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一条金矿脉的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a vein of gold with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一条金矿脉和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a vein of gold｜一条金矿脉
tip: vein指静脉；artery指动脉，二者不是反义词。

senses.en: tiny sea animals, or the hard structures they build
having a pinkish-orange colour

ex.en: Office hours began with coral reef.
ex.zh: 答疑从珊瑚礁开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around coral reef.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕珊瑚礁展开说明。

tip: 指珊瑚材料通常不可数；指种类或群体时可用corals。

senses.en: Including many facts or specific pieces of information.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on detailed description.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论详细描述。

ex.en: The author returns to detailed description when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了详细描述。

tip: 表示“详细地”用in detail，不用in detailed。

senses.en: a person with important management responsibilities in an organisation
relating to managing an organisation or putting decisions into effect
the part of a government or organisation that implements decisions

ex.en: Office hours began with senior executive.
ex.zh: 答疑从高级管理人员开始。

ex.en: The author returns to senior executive when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了高级管理人员。

tip: 名词可指高管；形容词常修饰power、board等。

senses.en: relating to activities within a particular country
relating to the home, family, or household tasks
kept by people rather than living in the wild

ex.en: Our professor circled domestic market on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了国内市场。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of domestic market.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得国内市场这个例子。

tip: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。

senses.en: An icy object orbiting the sun, sometimes showing a bright tail

ex.en: Office hours began with a passing comet.
ex.zh: 答疑从经过的彗星开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a passing comet.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得经过的彗星这个例子。

tip: comet是彗星；meteor是进入大气后发光的流星。

senses.en: Connected with religion and deserving deep respect
Considered too important or valuable to change or harm

ex.en: I copied sacred site into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把圣地抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sacred site.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论圣地的材料。

col: hold something sacred｜视某物为神圣
tip: sacred可指宗教上的神圣，也指极珍视、不可侵犯。

senses.en: to become darker or make something darker
to become or make someone look unhappy or angry

ex.en: I heard the lecturer darken the sky during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使天空变暗。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers darken the sky before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使天空变暗。

col: someone's face darkens｜某人脸色阴沉下来
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：云使天变暗，天也可自行变暗。

senses.en: An unfair difference in wealth, opportunity, or treatment.

ex.en: The seminar traced inequality in who can afford unpaid internships.
ex.zh: 研讨课追溯了谁负担得起无薪实习这一问题中的不平等。

ex.en: The reading asks whether the policy reduced inequality or only moved it.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读问这项政策是减少了不平等，还是只是把它转移了。

tip: 常用 income / social / gender inequality。

senses.en: Make jokes about someone, playfully or unkindly.
Someone who enjoys making jokes about other people.

ex.en: The professor asked us to tease out.
ex.zh: 教授让我们梳理出；逐步弄清。

ex.en: The passage says students who can tease out follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够梳理出；逐步弄清的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: tease someone about something｜拿某事取笑某人
tip: 常用tease sb about sth；可亲昵，也可伤人。

senses.en: Used to compare two facts that differ.

ex.en: The first group improved, whereas the second did not.
ex.zh: 第一组有进步，而第二组没有。

ex.en: The lecture uses whereas to contrast a lab task with a real semester of study.
ex.zh: 讲座用 whereas 对比实验室任务和真实的一学期学习。

tip: whereas 连接两个完整分句，前面常用逗号。

senses.en: A senior official representing their country in another country.
Someone who publicly represents or promotes a group or cause.

ex.en: Office hours began with goodwill ambassador.
ex.zh: 答疑从亲善大使开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around goodwill ambassador.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕亲善大使展开说明。

tip: 驻某国大使用 ambassador to，不用 for。

senses.en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about herb garden.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于香草园的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects herb garden with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把香草园和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 英音h发音，美音通常不发；对应a herb和an herb。

senses.en: To meet requirements, or make someone suitable for something.
To complete the training needed for a profession.
To limit a statement so it is more accurate.

ex.en: The assignment is to qualify for assistance, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先符合援助条件，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers qualify for assistance before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要符合援助条件。

col: qualify for assistance｜符合援助条件
qualify as a teacher｜取得教师资格
tip: qualify for接机会或待遇；qualify as接职业。
